title: ID0429322-DC/Si-D/EE-Bender issue
description:
Last month we had an issue with the right CCS at charger ID 170001466 (Saue). When I checked the bender controller everything seemed fine and the CCS connector started working again.
We agreed to monitor it for any problems. Unfortunately it seems that the problem with the bender controller returned. Can you check if it is the same problem as before?
Should we replace the bender controller?
